description: Read the inbound event log for the account. Returns one row per received message with the mailbox it landed in, the sender, the subject line and the message id — no message bodies. Use `after` to resume from the previous page's `nextCursor`, and the filters to narrow the page (a case-insensitive substring for `subject`). Call `get_email` with a row's `messageId` to read the content.

after.description: Resume after this event id (the `nextCursor` of the previous call). Omit to read from the start.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

recipient.description: Only events for this mailbox address (exact match).

sender.description: Only events from this sender address (exact match).

subject.description: Only events whose subject contains this text (case-insensitive substring).

name: list_events
